subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3464
title: Provides that when a person is charged with committing a new felony sex crime while on pretrial release for a felony sex crime, the person is only eligible for release after a hearing during which the court determines whether security release may be denied, and if security release is allowed, the person must deposit the full security amount set by the court.
headline: HB 3464 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3464 was introduced in the House on February 4, 2025.
HB 3464 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
